name: dsh-code-card-fonts
description: Local persistent Web UI patch: pins the content font-size axis to 14px (the ui-theme font-size setting is locked at 14 and its persisted value is normalized), 14px conversation-card titles, summaries, content and code, plus message-card spacing at half the content font height. TypeScript: host half index.ts (type stripping), browser half src/client.ts → lib/client.js (esbuild).
